title: CISA Adds Three Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog
summary: CISA has added three new vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog , based on evidence of active exploitation. CVE(s) Daemon Tools Lite Embedded Malicious Code Vulnerability CVE(s) TanStack Unspecified Vulnerability CVE(s) Nx Console Embedded Malicious Code Vulnerability These types of vulnerabilities are frequent attack vectors for malicious cyber actors and pose significant risks to the federal enterprise.
